async def act(page):
    # Click on the Catalog link to open its menu
    await page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name=" Catalog").click()
    # Wait for the menu to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click on the Products link within the Catalog menu
    # Use a more specific selector to avoid ambiguity
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Products", exact=True).click()
    # Wait for navigation to the products page
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Now on the products page, search for 'Phoebe Zipper Sweatshirt'
    # Assuming there's a search input field; use appropriate role
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search").fill("Phoebe Zipper Sweatshirt")
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Click on the product to edit it
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Phoebe Zipper Sweatshirt").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
